title: Travel Insurance
intro: International travel insurance pays for medical emergencies abroad plus trip and baggage problems; check the medical cover, the deductibles and sub-limits, pre-existing disease rules and how reliably the insurer pays claims.
sources: Insurer brochures, prospectuses, rate charts and product pages (Oct 2026)
Insurer public disclosures (Form NL-37) FY2024-25 via Ditto Data Lab and PolicyX
IRDAI Annual Report 2024-25 (no insurer-wise travel CSR published)

params.label: Max medical cover (USD)
params.tip: Highest medical sum insured across the plan's variants (Oct 2026). Some are per incident.

params.label: Trip / flight delay cover
params.tip: Top variant's delay benefit as published (Oct 2026).

params.label: Checked baggage loss (USD, max)
params.tip: Top variant's limit for total loss of checked-in baggage (Oct 2026).

params.label: Pre-existing disease in emergency (base plan)
params.tip: Life-threatening pre-existing illness covered without a paid add-on (Oct 2026).

params.label: Insurer claim settlement ratio
params.tip: Insurer's overall health CSR by number, FY2024-25 (NL-37 disclosures). Travel-specific CSR is rarely published.

params.label: Indicative premium: 7-day Schengen, age 30
params.tip: Cheapest Schengen-eligible rate from the filed rate chart, before tax (2025-26). Null if not published.

params.label: Covid-19 cover
params.tip: Insurer states Covid-19 treatment is covered (Oct 2026).

items.name: Tata AIG Travel Insurance – International Plus (Travel Guard Plus)

v.notes: Titanium Plus: unlimited sum insured, USD 1M per incident; PED life-threatening up to USD 20,000. Premium = Schengen Silver, 5-7 days, age up to 40.

pros: Top plan has no overall cap, USD 1M per incident
Life-threatening PED covered on all plans (USD 2,500–20,000)
Separate Schengen variants and senior plans
items.best: Travellers wanting a very high medical ceiling and built-in PED emergency cover

items.name: ICICI Lombard International Travel Insurance

v.notes: Plan names and benefits from aggregator summaries; current line-up not confirmed on insurer site.

pros: Platinum adds compassionate visit and hotel extension
Large insurer with wide assistance network
items.best: Healthy travellers who want a large-insurer brand

items.name: Care Health Explore

v.notes: Life-threatening PED cover is an optional benefit: up to 10% of sum insured. Explore Europe sold in EUR (30K/100K).

cons: PED emergency cover only as optional benefit
Sub-limits on lower variants and ages 61+
items.best: Schengen visa travellers and older travellers

items.name: Niva Bupa TravelAssure

v.trip_delay: USD 25–50 per 4h, up to 24h of delay
v.notes: Variants: Lite, Basic, Comprehensive, Pro, Adventure & Sports. PED life-threatening USD 2,500–10,000, USD 100 deductible. Covid quarantine trip cancellation covered.

pros: No inpatient sub-limits on top variants
cons: Lite variant has thin non-medical cover
items.best: Travellers who want to customise benefits

items.name: Bajaj General Travel Insurance (Prime / Elite / ACE / Companion)

v.notes: USD 1M on Travel Prime (age-dependent); Elite and ACE up to USD 500K. PED life-threatening USD 3,000 (USD 5,000 on ACE Platinum). Figures via nriol.com.

pros: Companion plan covers ages up to 99
items.best: Families and seniors wanting a high-CSR insurer

items.name: HDFC ERGO Explorer

v.notes: PED emergency cover is an add-on (if declared; max USD 10,000). Premium = Silver USD 40K, Europe incl. Schengen, 0-7 days, age 0-40, excl. taxes.

pros: Public rate chart; cheapest filed Schengen rate found
cons: Small baggage and delay caps on lower covers
items.best: Budget Schengen trips and travellers wanting high cover

items.name: IndusInd General Travel Insurance (formerly Reliance Travel Care)

v.notes: PED covered if declared and life-threatening. Separate Schengen plan EUR 30K/50K. USD 50 medical deductible.

pros: PED emergency covered in base plan
Ages 3 months to 90, no medical check-up
cons: Delay paid per day, not per hour

items.name: Digit International Travel Insurance (Smart / Smart 360)

v.notes: PED life-threatening cover only on Smart 360 or with waiver add-on (USD 5K–10K). Separate instant payout for 6h+ flight delay.

pros: Highest insurer CSR in this list (FY2024-25)

items.name: SBI General Travel Insurance (Business and Holiday)

v.notes: Baggage shares a USD 2,000 floater with other travel benefits (5% deductible). Older 2013-era product.

items.name: Generali Central Jet Set Secure

v.notes: PED cover (USD 5K–15K) sold as optional add-on; base-plan emergency PED not confirmed.

items.best: Travellers who want add-ons like adventure sports

items.name: IFFCO Tokio Overseas Travel Protector

v.notes: Platinum 1000: unlimited SI, USD 1M per incident, USD 100 deductible. PED life-threatening sub-limit up to USD 20,000. Premium = Bronze 50, Schengen, 5-7 days, age to 40 (rate chart; currency/tax assumed INR pre-tax).

cons: Sub-limited variants cap room, ICU, surgery
Top plans only up to age 60
items.best: Value Schengen trips with high cover options

v.notes: Base PED cover limited to emergency pain relief; fuller PED optional. USD 100K per-illness cap above USD 100K SI except Platinum Plus/Schengen plans.
